description: This source file defines the EventHubPartitionCheckpointEntity class, which represents a checkpoint entity for an Event Hub partition in Azure Table Storage. It implements the ITableEntity interface and provides methods for creating partition and row keys, as well as properties for storing checkpoint information such as offset and timestamp.

classes.name: EventHubPartitionCheckpointEntity
classes.description: Represents a checkpoint for an Event Hub partition, storing metadata such as offset, partition key, row key, timestamp, and ETag for concurrency control.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new checkpoint entity with specified stream provider name, service ID, and partition.

methods.name: MakePartitionKey
methods.description: Generates a sanitized partition key string based on stream provider name and checkpoint namespace.

methods.name: MakeRowKey
methods.description: Generates a sanitized row key string based on partition.
